text:
I recorded 6 candidates: 3 rooms, each with a Standard and an Advance purchase rate. I stopped on the availability list and didn't reserve anything. The page shows euro guide prices, so I switched it to GBP, which is what the hotel charges. All figures below are GBP totals for the 2 nights.

The best match is the **Garden Room, Standard rate, GBP 190**. It is cancellable free of charge up to 3 days before arrival, has no add-ons, and is paid on arrival. Next cheapest are the Tower Room Standard at GBP 280 and the Family Suite Standard at GBP 330.

| Room | Standard (cancellable) | Advance purchase |
|---|---|---|
| Garden Room | 190 | 171 |
| Tower Room | 280 | 252 |
| Family Suite | 330 | 297 |

- **Rejected rates:** the three Advance purchase rates are 10% cheaper but are paid in full today with no refund, so the scoring rejected them for failing the cancellable requirement.
- **Visitor levy:** the page says a levy of GBP 2.50 per person per night is paid at the hotel and isn't in the room price. For 2 guests over 2 nights that is GBP 10, which I recorded as a known fee on every candidate.
- **Budget not applied:** the traveller's limit of 3000 SEK was not applied, because the hotel prices in GBP and I didn't convert it. The traveller needs to give a limit in GBP, or say to go on without one.
